# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org is usebounce, listed with the website usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is committed in usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app is on react-native 0.74.5 per package.json ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).
- The iOS listing has 12,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- There were 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- Bounce links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://usebounce.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles are listed there.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), top contributor to usebounce/bounce-app with 118 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.

## Why now

bounce-app was last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 118 commits in bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)), and it builds with an eas.json alongside GitHub Actions workflows in the repo ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). Five App Store releases in the last 90 days on React Native 0.74.5 ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349), [source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)). When a fix needs to reach those users, does it go out over the air, or does every one of those five go through a full store review?
